 Follow Kitchen & Dining Products View feed Owala Just Brought Back Its Viral Diet Coke Tumbler With 3 New Styles 
 We'll happily sip to that!
 By Abby Dupes Published: Nov 16, 2026 4:14 PM EST Save Article Share Article We've been independently researching and testing products for over 120 years. If you buy through our links, we may earn a commission. Learn more about our review process. 
 2 min read Owala and Coca-Cola are proving that their first collaboration was just the beginning. After releasing a Diet Coke-inspired collection exclusively at Target last year, the brands are expanding the lineup with three new designs.
 The latest offerings, which launched exclusively on Amazon on November 16, include four 24-ounce tumblers priced at $34.99 each. Along with the new Coca-Cola styles, fans will have another chance to shop the silver Diet Coke tumbler from the original release.
 Owala Diet Coke Classic
 Owala Diet Coke Classic
 $35 Amazon Diet Coke loyalists will immediately recognize the returning silver tumbler, an oversized version of the familiar soda can with its metallic finish and red lettering. For those who prefer the original Coke, there's a bright red tumbler with the iconic white script, plus a white version covered in subtle, raised Coca-Cola logos.
 My personal favorite, though, is the vintage-inspired design. With its green-and-cream stripes and retro "Ice Cold Coca-Cola" emblem, it reminds me of an old-fashioned soda fountain.
 Owala Classic Coca-Cola
 $35 at Amazon Owala Coca-Cola Vintage Stripe
 $35 at Amazon Owala Red Coca-Cola
 $35 at Amazon During water bottle testing , the Good Housekeeping Institute Kitchen Appliances Lab evaluated the brand's tumblers for insulation and durability. The analysts found that the 24-ounce tumbler kept drinks cold for hours and fit into most of the cupholders they tested.
 The two-in-one lid is another handy detail, offering both a removable straw and a sliding opening for sipping. Just don't mistake splash-resistant for leakproof, and remember to hand-wash the cup itself.
 At $35 each, they'd make a great holiday gift for the DC devotee in your life. I'd even throw in a gift card to their favorite lunch spot so they can enjoy their usual order on you. Cheeseburger and fries? Caesar salad? Whatever they like to pair with their soda, lunch is covered.
